BUILDING CONSTRUCTION — TERMLY EXAM #20
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: BUILDING CONSTRUCTION
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Computer Aided Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Computer Aided Drawing.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Computer Aided Drawing.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer Aided Drawing.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Computer Aided Drawing.

2. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Overload every socket
   B. Ignore burnt cables
   C. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   D. Never touch live wires with wet hands

3. When learning Foundations, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Foundations.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Foundations.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Foundations.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Foundations.

4. When learning Concreting 3.2 Foundations 3.3 Timbering 3.4 Foundation Walling 3.5 Ground Floor, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Concreting 3.2 Foundations 3.3 Timbering 3.4 Foundation Walling 3.5 Ground Floor.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Concreting 3.2 Foundations 3.3 Timbering 3.4 Foundation Walling 3.5 Ground Floor.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Concreting 3.2 Foundations 3.3 Timbering 3.4 Foundation Walling 3.5 Ground Floor.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Concreting 3.2 Foundations 3.3 Timbering 3.4 Foundation Walling 3.5 Ground Floor.

5. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Work alone with eyes closed
   B. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   C. Run with the tool
   D. Remove all guards

6. When learning Site Preparation, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Site Preparation.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Site Preparation.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Site Preparation.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Site Preparation.

7. When learning Timbering, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Timbering.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Timbering.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Timbering.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Timbering.

8. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Information and Communication Technology
   B. Internal Cooking Timer
   C. International Cricket Team
   D. Input Cable Tester

9. When learning Isometric Drawing 2.2 Computer Aided Drawing 3.0 Building Construction Processes, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Isometric Drawing 2.2 Computer Aided Drawing 3.0 Building Construction Processes.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Isometric Drawing 2.2 Computer Aided Drawing 3.0 Building Construction Processes.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Isometric Drawing 2.2 Computer Aided Drawing 3.0 Building Construction Processes.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Isometric Drawing 2.2 Computer Aided Drawing 3.0 Building Construction Processes.

10. When learning Site Preparation 2.0 Related Drawing 2.1 Isometric Drawing 2.2 Computer Aided Dr, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Site Preparation 2.0 Related Drawing 2.1 Isometric Drawing 2.2 Computer Aided Dr.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Site Preparation 2.0 Related Drawing 2.1 Isometric Drawing 2.2 Computer Aided Dr.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Site Preparation 2.0 Related Drawing 2.1 Isometric Drawing 2.2 Computer Aided Dr.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Site Preparation 2.0 Related Drawing 2.1 Isometric Drawing 2.2 Computer Aided Dr.

11. When learning Introduction to Building Construction, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Building Construction.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Building Construction.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Building Construction.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Building Construction.

12. When learning Isometric Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Isometric Drawing.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Isometric Drawing.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Isometric Drawing.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Isometric Drawing.

13. When learning Introduction to Building Construction 1.2 Site Preparation 2.0 Related Drawing 2, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Building Construction 1.2 Site Preparation 2.0 Related Drawing 2.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Building Construction 1.2 Site Preparation 2.0 Related Drawing 2.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Building Construction 1.2 Site Preparation 2.0 Related Drawing 2.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Building Construction 1.2 Site Preparation 2.0 Related Drawing 2.

14. When learning Timbering 3.4 Foundation Walling 3.5 Ground Floors 4.0 Building Services 4.1 Plu, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Timbering 3.4 Foundation Walling 3.5 Ground Floors 4.0 Building Services 4.1 Plu.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Timbering 3.4 Foundation Walling 3.5 Ground Floors 4.0 Building Services 4.1 Plu.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Timbering 3.4 Foundation Walling 3.5 Ground Floors 4.0 Building Services 4.1 Plu.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Timbering 3.4 Foundation Walling 3.5 Ground Floors 4.0 Building Services 4.1 Plu.

15. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. CPU
   B. Keyboard
   C. Speaker
   D. Monitor

16. When learning Concreting, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Concreting.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Concreting.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Concreting.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Concreting.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Concreting and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Foundations and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Timbering 3.4 Foundation Walling 3.5 Ground Floors 4.0 Building Services 4.1 Plu and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Timbering and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Foundation Walling and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Ground Floors 4.0 Building Services 4.1 Plumbing Tools and Equipment 4.2 Plumbin and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
